tasks.label: Keepwork: Publish Latest VSIX (Entra)
args: $candidate = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}' -File -Filter 'keepwork-*.vsix' | ForEach-Object { if ($_.BaseName -match '^keepwork-(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$') { [PSCustomObject]@{ File = $_; Version = [version]$Matches[1] } } } | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $candidate) { throw 'No keepwork-X.Y.Z.vsix package found in the workspace root.' }; Write-Host "Publishing $($candidate.File.Name)..."; $env:PATH = 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft SDKs\Azure\CLI2\wbin;' + $env:PATH; & '${workspaceFolder}\node_modules\.bin\vsce.cmd' publish --azure-credential --packagePath $candidate.File.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
